title: 706 Joe Morse Dr, Copperas Cove
description: Welcome to 706 Joe Morse Drive – a beautifully remodeled brick home nestled in an established Copperas Cove neighborhood. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home features fresh interior paint, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, and an updated kitchen that opens to a living area and formal dining room. Outside you can enjoy the fully fenced, oversized backyard. With its updates, layout, and location this home is move-in ready and waiting for its next owner!
channel: Elizabeth Thomas - Fort Hood Homes Group
